scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Setting up Crab Culture Unit
other_conditions: Resident of Goa for the last fifteen years
Must undergo a training programme on Crab Farming organized by the Fisheries Department, MPEDA, ICAR or other institutes
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1,50,000 per hectare (25% of cost) for setting up crab culture units and up to ₹75,000 per hectare (50% of cost) for seed and feed, each for up to 2 hectares.
